text:
marta: Hey folks — PR #7438 is failing CI on UI snapshots in the Ubuntu job. It passed locally for me, so not sure what's different. CI: https://ci.internal/runs/7438
ci-bot: Build failed on ubuntu-22 · jest-ui-tests · snapshot mismatch. To rerun: `/ci rerun 7438` or click 'rerun' in the CI UI.
devon: I remember this one — we had a flaky serialization order in that component. Could be nondeterministic props order or stray whitespace. Did you run `yarn test --updateSnapshot` locally?
marta: I ran with `--updateSnapshot` and it updated, but I'm hesitant to commit without verifying the diff. The failing snapshot shows a single prop moved and an extra newline. Paste of diff: ```- <Button label="Send" disabled=false />
+ <Button disabled=false label="Send" />
```
sree: That reorder looks like React devtools or stringify ordering. If the rerun on CI produces the same diff, it's probably safe to update, but we should get one more pair of eyes. Also note: we have a short merge freeze until 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC for the canary rollout — if this is urgent we need to coordinate.
olivia: I can do the review + approve after CI is green. @devon can you trigger the rerun? I don't have rerun perms in the flaky-jobs group.
devon: Kicking a rerun now: `/ci rerun 7438` — started. Will post status.
ci-bot: Rerun started by devon · rerun id 1781234579.
ci-bot: Rerun completed — ubuntu-22: jest-ui-tests PASSED, mac-latest: flaky-timeout FAILED (intermittent), but rerun job marked overall success since required checks passed.
marta: Huh, mac job timed out in an unrelated E2E. Looks transient. The snapshot job passed on rerun and the updated snapshot diff matches my local update.
sree: Given the freeze window, I'd prefer to hold merging until after 18:00 UTC unless this is blocking a hotfix. Otherwise, update the snapshot, request Olivia's approval, and we'll merge in the next merge window.
marta: Sounds good. I'll push the snapshot update + note in PR that this is an ordering-only change.
olivia: I'll review once you push. If it looks safe I'll approve and tag for merge after the freeze. :thumbsup:
devon: small reminder — add a short PR comment explaining why the snapshot changed (ordering). Helps future triage.
marta: Will do — thanks all.
ci-bot: Note: logs for the mac timeout saved at https://ci.internal/logs/1781234579/mac-timeout, follow-up issue created <#eng-infra>.
